purpose: Track rights and provenance for project-owned and third-party assets before import, training, integration, or distribution.
rules: Empty ledger means no asset has been cleared by this ledger; it does not prove that the repository contains no third-party material.
Never infer permission from public accessibility or source-hosting platform.
Third-party content must not be imported or shipped while rights review is pending.
Keep source links, exact revisions, checksums and license evidence for audit.
